verdict.rationale: Okta exposes broad Admin Management and SCIM APIs plus an official MCP server that lets an AI agent create users, manage groups, and query app/login data (okta-docs-2/3/9, okta-gh-1/2/3), suggesting substantial UI-API parity for identity administration tasks. However, there is no explicit vendor claim of full UI/API parity, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs (llms.txt/docs.md 404, no openapi.json), undermining confidence that every UI capability is exposed programmatically. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, a published OpenAPI/machine-readable schema, and independent confirmation that all admin console features have API equivalents.
